instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to solve the problem.

atoms.a: Marley cut up two pizzas into eighths. He ate 3/8 of the first pizza and 7/8 of the second pizza. How much pizza did Marley eat in total?
Finn wrote 1/3 of his story on Monday and 2/3 of his story on Tuesday. How much of his story has he written?
Connie used 8/12 of a gigabyte of her phone data last month but only 5/12 of a gigabyte of her phone data this month. How many gigabytes of data has she used in the last two months?
Sarah tried three different chocolate bars. She ate 1/6 of the first chocolate bar, 4/6 of the second and 5/6 of the third. How much chocolate did Sarah eat?

The Wright family are going on a road trip. They complete 4/20 of the journey before stopping at a petrol station. They then continue for 10/20 of their journey before stopping for lunch. They continue for 3/20 of their journey before they get a flat tyre. How far have they come in their journey?
